name: Adversarial Reviewer
use_when: Finds flaws, ambiguities, and misleading statements in skill documents — Phase 1-B for skill-review domain — when you need a rigorous adversarial pass that challenges every claim and assumption.

name: Audience and Context Analyst
use_when: Extracts audience profile, presentation format, and style constraints — Phase 1-B for slides domain — when you need to understand the delivery context, format constraints, and brand requirements.

name: Business Analyst (PM)
use_when: Extracts business objectives, resource constraints, and success metrics — Phase 1-B for pm domain — when you need to understand business context, monetization model, and strategic priorities.

name: Content Analyst
use_when: Extracts factual claims, data points, and source materials — Phase 1-B for writing domain — when you need to gather evidence, references, and verifiable claims from source material.

name: Design Systems Analyst
use_when: Extracts platform constraints, brand guidelines, and component library rules — Phase 1-B for design domain — when you need to understand the technical and brand constraints that shape the design system.

name: Technical Analyst
use_when: Extracts technical constraints, security requirements, and data models — Phase 1-B for code domain — when you need to understand system boundaries, performance requirements, and technical architecture.

name: Code Breaker
use_when: Validates code for phantom output, contract compliance, and correctness — Phase 3 breaker for code domain — when validating code implementation before acceptance.

name: Copy Editor
use_when: Validates written sections for clarity, accuracy, tone consistency, and coverage — Phase 3 breaker for writing domain — when validating a written section before acceptance.

name: Design Quality Reviewer
use_when: Validates component specs for completeness, accessibility, and design system consistency — Phase 3 breaker for design domain — when validating a component spec before acceptance.

name: Product Spec Reviewer
use_when: Validates feature specs for clarity, acceptance criteria completeness, and strategic alignment — Phase 3 breaker for pm domain — when validating a feature spec before acceptance.

name: QA Reviewer (Finding)
use_when: Validates finding quality, recommendation actionability, and git patch correctness — Phase 3 breaker for skill-review domain — when validating a finding writeup before acceptance.

name: Slide Quality Reviewer
use_when: Validates slide content for narrative fit, bullet clarity, and speaker note quality — Phase 3 breaker for slides domain — when validating slide content before acceptance.

name: Content Lead
use_when: Decomposes approved outline into atomic writing tasks — Phase 3 decompose for writing domain — when turning an outline into individual section writing tasks.

name: Design Lead
use_when: Decomposes design spec into atomic component specification tasks — Phase 3 decompose for design domain — when turning a design spec into individual component or screen state tasks.

name: Product Lead
use_when: Decomposes product strategy into atomic feature specification tasks — Phase 3 decompose for pm domain — when turning a product strategy into individual feature spec tasks.

name: Review Lead
use_when: Decomposes skill review plan into atomic actionable findings — Phase 3 decompose for skill-review domain — when turning a review plan into individual finding tasks.

name: Technical Lead
use_when: Decomposes locked specification into atomic implementation tasks — Phase 3 decompose for code domain — when turning a technical design into implementation tasks with API contracts.

name: Financial Investment Analyst
use_when: Analyzes investment opportunities, evaluates risk/return profiles, and provides investment recommendations with deep domain knowledge in capital markets, asset valuation, and risk management.

name: Financial Reviewer
use_when: Validates financial analyses for completeness, accuracy, assumptions validity, risk disclosure, and regulatory compliance across all finance domains.

name: Financial Technical Analyst
use_when: Analyzes price action, chart patterns, technical indicators, and market microstructure for timing and risk assessment in financial markets.

name: Investment Quality Reviewer
use_when: Validates investment recommendations for suitability, risk alignment, fiduciary compliance, and quality standards; final gatekeeper before accepting recommendations into deliberation output.

name: Macroeconomic Analyst
use_when: Analyzes economic cycles, monetary/fiscal policy impacts, and broad market trends with expertise in business cycle theory, international economics, and scenario forecasting.

name: Microeconomic Analyst
use_when: Analyzes company fundamentals, financial health, competitive positioning, and intrinsic value with deep expertise in financial statement forensics and multi-method valuation.

name: Money Flow Analyst
use_when: Tracks capital movements, liquidity conditions, and funding flows across markets with expertise in market microstructure, liquidity analysis, and cross-market capital flows.

name: Portfolio Manager
use_when: Constructs and optimizes portfolios, manages asset allocation, and monitors portfolio health using MPT, factor investing, risk budgeting, and multi-asset strategies.

name: Sentiment Analyst
use_when: Gauges market sentiment, positioning extremes, behavioral biases, and contrarian opportunities with expertise in behavioral finance and positioning data analysis.

name: Trading Strategist
use_when: Develops trading strategies across timeframes, defines entry/exit rules, and manages trade execution with expertise in market microstructure, systematic trading, and risk management.

name: Audience Analyst
use_when: Extracts target audience profile and communication goals — Phase 1-A for writing domain — when you need to understand who the content is for and what it should accomplish.

name: Business Analyst
use_when: Extracts business rules and product features from input documents — Phase 1-A for code domain — when you need to isolate user flows, business goals, and product features from technical noise.

name: Communications Strategist
use_when: Extracts core arguments and key data points for presentations — Phase 1-A for slides domain — when you need to identify the main takeaways and call-to-action from source material.

name: Product Researcher
use_when: Extracts user needs and market opportunities — Phase 1-A for pm domain — when you need to surface user needs, customer pain points, and market opportunities from source material.

name: Technical Documentation Auditor
use_when: Audits agent skill documents for completeness and operational gaps — Phase 1-A for skill-review domain — when you need to identify what guidance is missing, undocumented, or referenced but absent.

name: UX Researcher
use_when: Extracts user flows, pain points, and jobs-to-be-done — Phase 1-A for design domain — when you need to understand user needs and accessibility requirements.

name: Code Maker
use_when: Writes production-quality code against API contracts — Phase 3 maker for code domain — when implementing a single task from the decomposed specification.

name: Component Designer
use_when: Writes detailed design specification for a component — Phase 3 maker for design domain — when writing a component spec from the decomposed design spec.

name: Feature Writer
use_when: Writes feature specification with user story, acceptance criteria, and success metrics — Phase 3 maker for pm domain — when writing a feature spec from the decomposed product strategy.

name: Slide Content Writer
use_when: Writes complete slide content with headline, bullets, speaker notes, and visual description — Phase 3 maker for slides domain — when writing a single slide from the decomposed deck structure.

name: Technical Writer (Finding)
use_when: Produces detailed review finding with git patch — Phase 3 maker for skill-review domain — when implementing a single finding from the decomposed review plan.

name: Writer
use_when: Writes content sections following the approved outline — Phase 3 maker for writing domain — when writing a single section from the decomposed outline.

name: Code Maker (Fix)
use_when: Fixes a rejected code implementation to address critical failures — Phase 3 maker fix for code domain — when implementation was rejected by the breaker and needs surgical fixes.

name: Component Designer (Fix)
use_when: Revises a rejected component specification to address review failures — Phase 3 maker fix for design domain — when a component spec was rejected by the design reviewer and needs revision.

name: Feature Writer (Fix)
use_when: Revises a rejected feature spec to address reviewer failures — Phase 3 maker fix for pm domain — when a feature spec was rejected and needs revision focusing on acceptance criteria and success metrics.

name: Slide Content Writer (Fix)
use_when: Revises a rejected slide to address coach feedback — Phase 3 maker fix for slides domain — when a slide was rejected by the quality reviewer and needs revision.

name: Technical Writer (Finding Fix)
use_when: Revises a rejected finding writeup to address failures — Phase 3 maker fix for skill-review domain — when a finding was rejected by QA and needs surgical revision.

name: Writer (Fix)
use_when: Revises a rejected section to address editorial failures — Phase 3 maker fix for writing domain — when a section was rejected by the editor and needs revision.

name: Critical Stakeholder Reviewer
use_when: Examines product strategy for gaps, unmeasured criteria, and misaligned incentives — Phase 2 review for pm domain — when you need stakeholder-level scrutiny of the product strategy before decomposing into features.

name: Plan Challenger
use_when: Challenges review plan priorities and identifies systemic issues — Phase 2 review for skill-review domain — when you need to verify the review plan correctly identifies the most impactful issues.

name: Presentation Coach
use_when: Reviews deck structure for narrative gaps and missing proof — Phase 2 review for slides domain — when you need to verify the deck has a compelling story arc before slide writing begins.

name: QA Engineer
use_when: Generates negative test cases, edge cases, and failure scenarios for technical designs — Phase 2 review for code domain — when you need to stress-test API contracts and identify critical vulnerabilities.

name: Senior Editor
use_when: Reviews content outlines for logical gaps and structural issues — Phase 2 review for writing domain — when you need to verify the outline is complete and well-structured before writing begins.

name: Usability and Accessibility Specialist
use_when: Reviews design specs for usability issues and WCAG violations — Phase 2 review for design domain — when you need to verify the design spec is accessible and free of broken user flows.

name: Content Strategist
use_when: Creates detailed section-by-section content outlines with narrative arc — Phase 2 forward for writing domain — when you need to transform audience profile and sources into a structured content plan.

name: Presentation Architect
use_when: Designs full slide-by-slide structure with narrative arc and content types — Phase 2 forward for slides domain — when you need to turn key messages and context into a deck structure.

name: Review Plan Synthesizer
use_when: Synthesizes skill document review findings into a structured review plan — Phase 2 forward for skill-review domain — after ingest phases return completeness gaps and adversarial findings.

name: Senior Product Manager
use_when: Creates product strategy document with vision, roadmap, and OKRs — Phase 2 forward for pm domain — when you need to synthesize user/market insights and business context into a product strategy.

name: Senior UX Designer
use_when: Creates comprehensive design specification covering components and interactions — Phase 2 forward for design domain — when you need to translate user needs and constraints into a design specification.

name: Solution Architect
use_when: Creates unified technical design with concrete API contracts — Phase 2 forward for code domain — when you need to merge business rules and technical constraints into a buildable specification.

name: Deck Designer Reviser
use_when: Revises deck structure to address coach feedback on narrative and structure — Phase 2 revise for slides domain — when the presentation coach identified narrative gaps or density issues.

name: Designer Reviser
use_when: Revises design spec to address usability and accessibility issues — Phase 2 revise for design domain — when the usability review identified critical accessibility violations or broken user flows.

name: Outline Reviser
use_when: Revises content outline to address editor feedback — Phase 2 revise for writing domain — when the editor identified logical gaps or missing coverage in the outline.

name: Review Plan Reviser
use_when: Revises skill document review plan based on challenger feedback — Phase 2 revise for skill-review domain — when the challenger found issues with the original review plan priorities.

name: Solution Architect Reviser
use_when: Revises technical design to address QA findings and sharpen API contracts — Phase 2 revise for code domain — when QA identified critical vulnerabilities or vague contracts in the technical design.

name: Strategist Reviser
use_when: Revises product strategy to address stakeholder gap feedback — Phase 2 revise for pm domain — when stakeholders identified critical gaps in the product strategy.
